2. What helps

  • The steps you took, in order.
  • What you saw instead of what you expected.
  • The product name if it is about one product.
  • Whether it happens every time.

Problem with an order that has already been placed? Use Support instead, so we can find your order.

3. What we collect

Only what you type, plus your browser and screen size if you leave the box ticked. Do not include passwords, card numbers or other private details. The report is emailed to the team through FormSubmit, the same way as our feedback form. See the privacy notice.
